full_prompt_en: A square cinematic digital landscape shows a tiny solitary figure on a rocky rise beneath a luminous arc in a pale turquoise sky. The sky occupies the upper half as a smooth, slightly hazy blue-green field. A fine warm-white curve begins near the left horizon, rises to a broad apex above the center, and falls toward the right horizon, resembling a vast ring partly hidden behind the terrain. Its edge glows softly rather than casting a hard beam. A long band of blue-gray rock crosses the middle of the image from left to right. The slope rises at the left and descends toward a distant, silvery strip of water on the right. Near the central ridge, a very small upright person stands alone in near-black silhouette, providing a clear sense of scale against the enormous arc. The figure has no visible clothing detail or readable facial features. Across the foreground, rough stones, low tufts, and rust-red ground cover form an uneven patchwork. Warm amber-orange streaks flow between the cold slate-colored rocks, becoming denser near the lower center and left edge. The rock surfaces have small cracks and mottled highlights, while the plant-like cover appears granular and soft. Faint layered landforms recede through mist at the far left, and low horizontal bands of water or haze open at the right. Light is broad and cool from the bright sky, with additional warm glow along the arc and selected foreground patches; shadows gather gently in stone crevices without a single sharp cast direction. The image uses a low-to-mid eye-level view across the terrain, allowing the ridge to divide the earthly textures from the clean celestial field. No signs or lettering appear. The overall composition is expansive and meditative, setting an almost imperceptible human scale inside a strong contrast of cool geology, warm ground color, and improbable luminous geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感数字风景呈现一名孤独的小小人影立于岩石高处，上方浅青绿色天空中横跨一道发光弧线。天空占据上半部，是平滑而略有薄雾的蓝绿色域。一条纤细暖白曲线从左侧地平线附近升起，在中央上方形成宽阔弧顶，随后落向右侧地平线，像一只被地形遮住下半部的巨大圆环。它的边缘柔和发光，而非投出硬朗光束。一条蓝灰色岩石长带从左到右横跨画面中部。山坡在左侧升高，向右侧远处银色水带逐渐下降。中央山脊附近，一个十分微小的直立人物独自站在近黑剪影中，与巨大的弧线形成清晰尺度对比。人物没有可见衣物细节或可读的面部特征。前景中，粗糙石块、低矮草丛和锈红色地表植被形成参差拼块。暖琥珀橙色条带穿行于冷石板色岩石之间，在下部中央及左缘附近更加密集。岩石表面有细小裂缝和斑驳高光，植物般覆盖物则显得颗粒而柔软。远左的层叠地形在薄雾里退去，右侧展开低矮的水平水域或雾气带。光从明亮天空宽阔而冷地漫射下来，弧线及部分前景色块另有暖光；阴影轻轻聚于石缝，没有单一清晰投影方向。图像以接近平视的低至中等视点越过地形，让山脊分开地面的肌理与干净的天体色域。画中没有标牌或文字。整体构图开阔而沉思，把几乎微不可见的人类尺度置于冷色地质、温暖地表与不可思议的发光几何之间。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic digital image pairs expansive clean color fields with richly granular foreground material. Cool turquoise haze and slate-blue masses take up most of the space, while rust orange and amber gather in irregular low patches. A single thin luminous curve supplies precise geometry against organic, fractured textures. Very small dark marks provide scale without interrupting the openness. The foreground has crisp cracks and mottled grain, the middle distance is broader and calmer, and far layers lose contrast in atmospheric blue. Illumination is soft and diffuse, with a secondary warm rim glow that accents selected edges rather than washing over every surface. Large negative space above a low, uneven division gives the composition a monumental rhythm. The overall effect is serene but uncanny, balancing believable texture and distance with one restrained impossible form.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感数字图像把广阔干净的色域与颗粒丰厚的前景材质配对。冷青绿雾气与石板蓝团块占据大部分空间，锈橙与琥珀色则聚成不规则的低处斑块。一条纤细发光曲线以精确几何对照有机、断裂的肌理。十分微小的深色标记提供尺度，却不打断开放感。前景有清晰裂缝与斑驳颗粒，中景更宽阔平静，远处层次在大气蓝色中失去对比。照明柔和漫射，另有一道暖边缘光只强调部分边界，并不漫过每一处表面。低矮参差的分界线上方留下大幅负空间，赋予构图宏大节奏。整体效果宁静却奇异，以可信的肌理和距离平衡一种克制的不可能形态。
theme_en: A tiny figure beneath a glowing arc over a rust-colored rocky plain
theme_zh: 锈色岩原上发光弧线下的微小人影
name: Filip Hodas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
